text:
sam: quick idea — instead of a fixed quant decision per model, what if we route per-request based on a cheap entropy proxy computed on the first few tokens? low entropy -> FP8 (save cost), high entropy -> INT8/4-bit fallbacks. thoughts?

mia: love this. cheap proxy could be top-k mass or tokenwise entropy over first 8 tokens. should be <1ms on hotpath.

devin: main risk is oscillation on borderline requests. add hysteresis + a short cooldown (e.g., 500ms or N requests per session) so we don't flip every request. also bucketize thresholds per model.

igor: +1 on per-model thresholds. important: thresholds should live in quant-profile metadata and be adjustable without deploy. also we need per-customer overrides for enterprise SLAs.

rachel: ops ask — what telemetry do we need? I want metrics: decision_entropy, chosen_quant, fallback_triggered, quality_regression_flag. tie to per-route dashboards and alerts (p95 quality drop).

sam: agreed. sketch of decision logic:
```
proxy = avg_entropy(first_k_logits)
if proxy < T_fp8: use FP8
elif proxy > T_int8: use INT8
else: sample probabilistically (p = (T_int8 - proxy)/(T_int8 - T_fp8)) to smooth transitions
```
This gives smoother boundaries and lets us anneal thresholds.

mia: nice. also recommend shadow-mode for N days: run FP8 path in parallel and log quality delta using existing eval prompts. then compute degradation percentiles.

devin: on stability — add a rolling EMA of proxy per-client to avoid tiny bursts flipping path. EMA alpha tuned in sim.

igor: calibration step needed: run offline replay across 100k recent requests to find candidate T_fp8/T_int8 per model variant. save results to profile store.

sam: rollout plan:
1) prototype in runtime branch (no traffic)
2) shadow on staging with replay tests (run analytics)
3) 1% live shadowing for 48h (collect metrics)
4) 5% canary with auto-rollback triggers: >0.3% topline quality regression or >1% increase in human-reported errors
5) gradual ramp with telemetry gating

rachel: add runbook snippets: if fallback_rate spikes, revert to global INT8 for that model version and open incident. set alert threshold: fallback_rate > 5% sustained 10m.

sam: operational details: where compute proxy? pretty sure runtime edge (pre-quant) so we can avoid extra hops. need a tiny hook in the serving runtime and a fast lookup to profile store.

mia: implement as a pluggable DecisionHook in the runtime — keeps code isolated. we can A/B different proxies (entropy vs topk mass) by feature flag.

devin: perf note — computing logits for first K requires a forward pass anyway for generation; do it on warmup tokens or the prefix. watch memory on batched inferences.

igor: security/compliance note — per-tenant thresholds must be audited. surface change history in console.

sam: action items: @mia prototype DecisionHook + proxy (owner), @igor add profile metadata field + API (owner), @devin sim harness for replay and EMA tuning (owner), @rachel add telemetry and alert wiring (owner). I'll file a lightweight RFC with the thresholds template.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary window placeholder: 2026-04-02T03:00:00Z (pending approvals) :construction:

mia: acked, will start spike tomorrow. :thumbsup:

devin: I can run replay job once we have the hook — ping me when artifacts ready.

igor: will spec profile schema and admin API this week.

rachel: I'll add dashboard panels and the alert rule into infra.

sam: thanks all — this feels like a good path to get cost wins without surprising regressions.
